nodes.label: Whitelist vs Blacklist Binary Policy
nodes.rationale: Guard flags -w (whitelist) and -b (blacklist) are mutually exclusive: whitelist denies every binary except the listed ones (ls ALLOWED, bash/cat BLOCKED); blacklist denies only the listed binary (ls BLOCKED).

nodes.label: exe_supersede.h superseded-key tracking
nodes.rationale: A replaced binary's old dev:ino admits only processes exec'd before replacement, never a reused inode number.

nodes.label: attach -> unlock -> populate -> resolve -> re-sync ordering
nodes.norm_label: attach -> unlock -> populate -> resolve -> re-sync ordering
nodes.rationale: Invariant: a resource is never readable without a live guard attached; never move unlock or detach earlier.

nodes.label: Launch scan of whitelisted runtimes
nodes.rationale: Identity is the executable, so ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE/NODE_OPTIONS/--inspect run caller code as the whitelisted binary.

nodes.label: CONFIG post-AUTH daemon.conf editing (configedit.go)
nodes.rationale: Compare-and-swap write, reload, restore old bytes on failed reload; refused during an active grant.

nodes.label: FORWARD temporary -w/-b whitelist grants
nodes.rationale: Only path writing whitelist rows for other binaries; -w only where no row, -b only over GUARD_ALLOW; CAS revoke.

nodes.label: swap_benign / swap_reader in-place binary swap POC
nodes.norm_label: swap_benign / swap_reader in-place binary swap poc
nodes.rationale: Guard pins admitted binary's content hash, re-verifies every 10s, demotes to GUARD_BLOCK on change.

nodes.label: edit-protected live-edit grant (control socket)
nodes.rationale: Real escalation path: 0600 socket + SO_PEERCRED uid 0 + peer exe inode check; AUTH before any watch path disclosure; single session; auth lockout.

nodes.label: temp-grants.json journal-before-write
nodes.rationale: Lets daemon --lockdown / next start strip -w rows from a SIGKILLed daemon's pinned maps; strip-only so a forged journal can deny, never admit.

nodes.label: Binary ledger (/etc/app-listener/binaries.db)
nodes.rationale: Nothing guards whitelisted paths while the daemon is stopped, so each start/reload checks binaries against recorded hashes.

nodes.label: bpf_loop() helper
nodes.rationale: Sets guard kernel floor at 5.17; callback re-simulated until convergence since 6.7.

nodes.label: static __noinline BPF-to-BPF helpers with args struct
nodes.norm_label: static __noinline bpf-to-bpf helpers with args struct
nodes.rationale: Max 5 register args; one args struct per hook; 512-byte stack across call chain.

nodes.label: rename-over-guarded-file bypass
nodes.rationale: Fix checks destination victim inode against watch root without a dentry walk, leaving guard_path_rename's verifier budget untouched.

nodes.label: Verifier gate workflow
nodes.rationale: Loads every guard eBPF program into two runner kernels (6.17, 7.0) because pruning differs per kernel; fails on any rejection incl. E2BIG; warns within 10% of budget.

nodes.label: __always_inline helper expansion cost
nodes.rationale: check_and_emit_ex inlined at 43 sites; out-of-lining took path_rename 959k -> 704k insns.

nodes.label: Map key/value type mismatch trap
nodes.rationale: Verifier checks only size of initialized stack, so wrong-typed keys load fine and silently miss.

nodes.label: BPF verifier 1M-insn complexity budget
nodes.rationale: Verifier walks every path; inlined helpers re-explored per call site dominate cost, not loop bounds.

nodes.label: CheckBPFLSM preflight
nodes.rationale: A hook attached on a kernel without bpf in the active LSM list silently denies nothing, so enforcing modes refuse to start.

nodes.label: Ports & adapters layering (cmd -> usecase -> repository -> engines)
nodes.norm_label: ports & adapters layering (cmd -> usecase -> repository -> engines)

nodes.label: daemon --check / --verifier-only preflight
nodes.rationale: --verifier-only skips only BPF-LSM activation check for CI hosts that build it in without enabling it.

nodes.label: Fail-closed principle
nodes.rationale: On any error (hook won't attach, unreadable map, bad config, unlock race) deny / refuse to start, never continue unprotected.

nodes.label: Inode-based (dev:ino) executable identity
nodes.rationale: Path, name, comm, argv are attacker-controlled; only exe dev:ino keys policy.

nodes.label: LSM link pinning under /sys/fs/bpf
nodes.rationale: SIGKILL leaves trees enforced until ExecStopPost re-locks vaults.

nodes.label: Exec-open attribution (whitelist mode)
nodes.rationale: Exec OPEN is attributed to the binary being executed so whitelisted binaries inside the guarded tree work from any wrapper.
